metadata.title: How ScanEat Works | QR Menus & WhatsApp Ordering
metadata.description: See exactly how ScanEat works: how diners scan, browse, and order, and how restaurant owners set up menus, manage live orders, and track performance.

hero.title: One platform, two simple journeys
hero.description: ScanEat connects diners and restaurant teams in real time — from a QR code scan on the table to a ticket in the kitchen to the numbers on your dashboard. Here's exactly how it works, step by step.

diner.title: From scan to served, without an app
diner.description: No downloads, no account required. Guests go from scanning a table QR code to placing an order in under a minute.

steps.title: 1. Scan the table QR or find a restaurant
steps.description: Point your phone camera at the table's QR code, or browse the ScanEat restaurant directory. Either way, the menu opens instantly in your browser — no app to download.

steps.title: 2. Browse the digital menu
steps.description: Scroll a clean, mobile-first menu with photos, prices, categories, and veg/non-veg tags. Search for a dish or filter by category in seconds.

steps.title: 3. Add to cart and choose how you'll order
steps.description: Add items to your cart, adjust quantities, and pick dine-in, pickup, or delivery depending on what the restaurant offers.

steps.title: 4. Checkout — sent straight to the restaurant
steps.description: Confirm your order and it's sent directly to the restaurant, ready to hand off over WhatsApp for a fast, familiar confirmation.

steps.title: 5. Track your order live, then rate your visit
steps.description: Watch your order move from received to preparing to ready in real time, then rate the restaurant and your favorite dishes afterward.

owner.title: From sign-up to sold out, all in one dashboard
owner.description: Everything a restaurant needs to run digital ordering — menu, QR codes, live orders, and analytics — in one role-based platform for owners, kitchen, and waiters.

steps.title: 1. Sign up and set up your restaurant
steps.description: Create your account, get a 30-day free trial, and set up your restaurant profile — branding, cuisine, and contact details — in minutes.

steps.title: 2. Build your digital menu
steps.description: Add categories and items with photos, prices, and descriptions. Toggle availability anytime — no reprinting, no waiting.

steps.title: 3. Generate and print your table QR codes
steps.description: Bulk-generate branded QR codes for every table, ready to print and place, each one linking straight to your live menu.

steps.title: 4. Manage live orders across your team
steps.description: Orders land on the kitchen screen the moment they're placed, move to the waiter screen when ready, and trigger an automatic WhatsApp update to the customer — all synced in real time.

steps.title: 5. Track performance and grow
steps.description: See revenue, order volume, average order value, and your top-selling items on one analytics dashboard, and manage staff, roles, and billing from the same place.

faq.title: Common questions about how ScanEat works

items.question: Do customers need to download an app?
items.answer: No. Diners scan a QR code or visit a link and the menu opens directly in their phone's browser.

items.question: How do orders reach the kitchen?
items.answer: The moment an order is placed, it appears instantly on the kitchen screen, then moves to the waiter screen when it's ready — no relaying orders by hand.

items.question: How does the customer get notified about their order?
items.answer: Orders are confirmed and updated over WhatsApp, and logged-in customers can also track status live from their own dashboard.

items.question: Can each table have its own QR code?
items.answer: Yes. You can generate a unique QR code per table so orders are tied to the right table automatically.

items.question: What does it cost to get started?
items.answer: Every restaurant gets a 30-day free trial with full access. After that, billing is handled directly with our team.

items.question: Do kitchen and waiter staff get their own screens?
items.answer: Yes. Owners, kitchen, and waiters each get a focused, role-based dashboard built for their part of the workflow.
